title: Ganjave et al. (2022) cybernetic fed-batch culture
description: One instance of the Ganjave growth model, integrated over 24 h in fed-batch mode on the feed recipe the paper reports as its selected optimum (17.5 % w/v glycerol, 24.5 % w/v yeast extract, 0.72 mL/h from 6 h). The three initial conditions the paper does not state are declared here as literals, because the model requires them and the adapter will not invent a default.
source_ref: Ganjave et al. 2022, Biotechnology Reports 33:e00694, doi:10.1016/j.btre.2021.e00694
notes: This graph runs the model; it does not reproduce the paper. The published time courses are figures, no figure was digitised, and the model's reproduction status is not_yet_validated. The three declared initial values are assumptions of this graph, not measurements from the paper.

instances.label: Cybernetic fed-batch culture, 24 h
instances.notes: Equations (12)-(16). The parameter set is the paper's Table 2, loaded as fitted; the adapter never overrides it.

ganjave_fed_batch/initial_biomass_concen.source_ref: Ganjave et al. 2022, 2.2 Batch fermentation, printed p. 2 (initial OD600 0.05, no OD600-to-dry-cell-weight calibration is printed)
ganjave_fed_batch/initial_biomass_concen.method: declared graph input; the paper states an initial OD600 but supplies no calibration, so this g/L value is an operator's assumption, not a paper value
ganjave_fed_batch/initial_biomass_concen.reason: Required by the model with no default. Not derivable from the reported OD600.

ganjave_fed_batch/initial_complex_substr.source_ref: Ganjave et al. 2022, printed p. 2 (SOB contains 5 g/L yeast extract)
ganjave_fed_batch/initial_complex_substr.method: declared graph input; the medium recipe's yeast-extract concentration is used as the initial lumped complex substrate
ganjave_fed_batch/initial_complex_substr.reason: Required by the model with no default. The paper states no initial S2 for the model, and this value decides whether the culture becomes oxygen-limited.

ganjave_fed_batch/initial_dissolved_oxyg.source_ref: Ganjave et al. 2022, Notations, printed p. 2 (DO is a percentage of dissolved oxygen)
ganjave_fed_batch/initial_dissolved_oxyg.method: declared graph input; the paper does not state an initial dissolved oxygen
ganjave_fed_batch/initial_dissolved_oxyg.reason: Required by the model with no default. A percentage of the probe's saturation reading, not a mass fraction and not a concentration.

ganjave_fed_batch/feed_glycerol_concentr.source_ref: Ganjave et al. 2022, 3.3, printed p. 7 (feed composition 17.5 % glycerol)
ganjave_fed_batch/feed_glycerol_concentr.method: reported feed recipe converted at 1 % w/v = 10 g/L
ganjave_fed_batch/feed_glycerol_concentr.reason: The concentration eq. (13) requires; the paper prints the recipe as percent weight/volume.

ganjave_fed_batch/feed_complex_substrate.source_ref: Ganjave et al. 2022, 3.3, printed p. 7 (feed composition 24.5 % yeast extract)
ganjave_fed_batch/feed_complex_substrate.method: reported feed recipe converted at 1 % w/v = 10 g/L
ganjave_fed_batch/feed_complex_substrate.reason: The concentration eq. (14) requires; the paper prints the recipe as percent weight/volume.

ganjave_fed_batch/feed_flow_rate.source_ref: Ganjave et al. 2022, 3.3, printed p. 7 (feed rate 0.72 mL/h)
ganjave_fed_batch/feed_flow_rate.reason: Volumetric, not a mass flow: a mass rate would need a feed density the paper does not state.

ganjave_fed_batch/feed_start_time.source_ref: Ganjave et al. 2022, 3.1, printed p. 3 (feeding begins at 6 h, at the dissolved-oxygen landmark)
ganjave_fed_batch/feed_start_time.reason: The pump starts at the dissolved-oxygen minimum the paper reports.
